description: Recreates HATCH entity boundaries as ordinary drawing entities (line/arc/circle/ellipse/polyline) via the HATCHB command, headless.

inputFile.description: Drawing containing the HATCH entities to recreate as boundary geometry.

params.description: Optional HatchBoundaryInput JSON — ProcessAllHatches (default true) or an explicit HatchHandles list. See Models/HatchBoundaryInput.cs. Omit to process every hatch in the drawing.

outputFile.description: Same drawing, saved in place after boundary entities were added. Shares input.dwg's localName deliberately — QSAVE writes back to the file accoreconsole already has open, which DA then uploads as the result. Avoids a SAVEAS-with-new-name script step that was never verified against real accoreconsole.
